scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and 159 finite exact-rational supporting checks; no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric stationary two-state Markov switching and integer expansion factors only.
The functional limit is annealed; the frozen endpoint has a stated one-time mixture limit.
The explicit variance and derivative, rather than the general functional CLT or transfer-operator identity, are the claimed contributions.
Indexed and inspected comparisons do not prove worldwide publication priority.
title: Markov persistence amplifies positional fluctuations of integer expanding maps
